title: Local fallback serves the combined crash camera and HD menu checkpoint
summary: The combined camera and menu checkpoint at d493be00f4d5f115b00d87e1b2f4f27b71dbffa9 was checked through the local deployment fallback after hosted Actions stalled.
details: The apex and Workers routes matched all 48 authored files plus the relay hash. The public actual-source Settings gate passed four viewports with 44-pixel touch targets, persistence, real driving and standalone HUD.

The public tight-crash gate passed 1,202 paired native gameplay/camera steps with zero mismatches. A single R2 package upload and full verification covered 525 served objects, 227 gallery entries and 175 screenshots; camera and UI gallery receipts were recorded.
limitation: This checkpoint records the checked local fallback while Actions was stalled; it does not claim the speed-rush checkpoint is live. Speed-rush remains separately host-only pending its remaining verification and release.
